name: Qatar Digital Library (QDL) — IIIF image service
notes: LIVE-WIRED §47 (the IMAGE-SOURCE class; probed 2026-11-26 from the build sandbox, multi-route): QDL serves page IMAGES only — no extractable text — which is exactly the witness class the owner's IMAGE-SOURCE AMENDMENT admits: the image IS the manuscript's full content. Routes tried: (1) item pages and the IIIF manifest on www.qdl.qa and the image service on iiif.qdl.qa — every route answers this sandbox egress with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge (the Najaf/SID egress position); (2) the Wayback Machine holds an archived copy of the Or 1997 manifest (snapshot 2024-09-30; 544 canvases, folio labels in the manifest itself) AND archived IIIF image responses for 350 of the 544 files, treatise V included at transcription grade (!1200,1200). End-to-end proof: image file 0196 (f. 92r, treatise V) fetched through the archived copy of the same IIIF response — real JPEG, 303,950 B, magic verified. The engine fetcher therefore tries the live IIIF service first and falls back to the archived copy of the same response; passages exist ONLY as genuine transcriptions of fetched page images (keyed Gemini vision), cited by shelfmark + folio. Metadata, catalogue records and curatorial descriptions NEVER count as passages.

name: القانون المسعودي — British Library Or 1997 (QDL IIIF witness)
notes: §47 WITNESS entry: al-Qanun al-Masudi complete (11 treatises), British Library: Oriental Manuscripts, Or 1997; copied in Baghdad, Rabi' I 570 AH (Sep-Oct 1174 CE); ff. iii+262+iii; 544 IIIF images; collation note Muharram 571 AH. Treatise ranges from the witness note: I ff. 5v-17v, II ff. 18r-51r, III ff. 52r-65v, IV ff. 66r-91r, V (geodesy) ff. 91v-109r, VI ff. 109v-131r, VII ff. 131v-158r, VIII ff. 158v-179r, IX ff. 179v-211v, X ff. 212r-242r, XI ff. 242v-262r. Folio<->image-file map derived from the IIIF manifest's OWN canvas labels (anchors verified across the codex: f. 5v = file 23, f. 84v = 181, f. 91v = 195, f. 100r = 212, f. 109r = 230, f. 262r = 536): file = 2n + 12 (recto), 2n + 13 (verso); treatise V = files 195-230. Wired as search_qdl_images (tag qdl:iiif-image): for queries naming the work or al-Biruni it samples the treatise-V range, fetches page images (live IIIF, Wayback fallback), transcribes them with the keyed Gemini vision brain, and emits ONE primary candidate whose passages are those transcriptions under folio citations, tagged image-derived. Supersedes the witness note's pre-§47 'collation witness only' limitation: the note itself is updated with a §47 addendum, its history kept.
